name: branding-color-palette-with-hex-rgb-cmyk-quadrants
title: Four-quadrant palette: white, botanical lime, soft grey, black
whatItIs: A 2x2 grid of full-bleed colour blocks. Each names a role (core background, primary accent, supporting elements, action and emphasis) with big light type and HEX, RGB, CMYK values.
whatItMeans: Confident and systematic; one pale lime is the only colour, so it carries the whole brand.
techniques: Give every colour a job title, not just a name.
Present palettes as huge blocks so proportions are felt.
List colour values in a clean three-row spec.
Keep three neutrals and one accent to make the accent unmistakable.

vocabulary.definition: The function assigned to a colour (background, accent, action).
The one distinctive hue in a mostly neutral palette.
HEX, RGB and CMYK values for a colour.
A colour area extending to the edge.
